recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a young man with voluminous, curly blonde-brown hair, set against a mottled, textured studio backdrop. The composition features a dual-text header with a bold, yellow condensed sans-serif on the left and a white, casual script on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's hair volume creates the primary silhouette against the background
Yellow display text contrasts against the dark hair and muted background
White script provides a secondary, informal counterpoint to the rigid main title
Soft, warm lighting on the face creates a nostalgic, youthful glow
coreInvariants: High-volume, textured hair as a central feature
Warm, desaturated color palette with a single bright yellow accent

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up portrait, head and shoulders, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright yellow text at the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the yellow text, moves across to the script, then down to the subject's face and hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Upper third of the frame is primarily background and typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earth tones (brown, tan, beige) in the hair and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black of the shirt provides a solid base.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant yellow for the primary name text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the typography.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed grotesque and casual monoline script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Tall, narrow, uniform stroke width, flat terminals
Secondary text: Connected, fluid, medium-weight cursive
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, industrial condensed sans-serif with a soft, personal handwritten script.

preserve: Condensed proportions of the primary text
Yellow and white color scheme for text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tall, condensed, bold sans-serif aesthetic.
Captures the casual, connected handwritten feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a young man with very voluminous, messy curly blonde-brown hair wearing a black t-shirt. The background should be a mottled, textured studio wall in shades of warm beige and terracotta. Use soft, warm lighting typical of 1970s photography.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a bold, yellow, extra-condensed sans-serif font at the top left. Add the secondary title in a white, casual monoline script at the top right.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text yellow and condensed?
Is the secondary text white and script-based?
Is the hair the most prominent visual texture?
Is the background mottled and warm-toned?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for 1970s/80s analog film grain texture
Ensure the yellow text is legible against the background
Verify the script text feels handwritten rather than mechanical
Confirm the subject's hair has significant volume and texture
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus textured portrait with a split-header using a bold condensed sans-serif and a light script for a classic pop-idol aesthetic.
